s1.title: Who we are
s1.body: This website is published by the ACF association (Tunisia). For any question about your data, use the Contact page.

s2.title: Data we collect
s2.body: For an account: email address, display name and preferred language. For a public profile: the information you choose to publish. For the contact form: your name, email and message, forwarded by email and not kept on the site.

s3.title: Purposes
s3.body: Running your account, publishing approved profiles and content, answering your messages and keeping the site secure. No advertising, no selling of data.

s4.title: Hosting and processors
s4.body: Data is hosted by Supabase (database, authentication, files) and the site by Vercel. Emails go through Resend; bot protection through Cloudflare Turnstile.

s5.title: Embedded players
s5.body: YouTube, Spotify or SoundCloud players load only after you click; those services may then set their own cookies.

s6.title: Your rights
s6.body: Under Organic Law No. 2004-63 on the protection of personal data, you may access, correct or ask us to delete your data. You may also contact the INPDP.

s1.title: Purpose
s1.body: These terms govern the use of the ACF association’s website and its member areas.

s2.title: Accounts
s2.body: You are responsible for keeping your password and account information confidential.

s3.title: Published content
s3.body: You confirm that you hold the rights to what you publish. Profiles, events and articles are reviewed before publication; ACF may refuse or remove content that breaks the law or its values.

s4.title: External links
s4.body: Links to other sites are provided for convenience; ACF is not responsible for their content.

s5.title: Liability
s5.body: The site is provided as is. ACF does its best to keep information, especially event dates, accurate but cannot guarantee it.

s6.title: Governing law
s6.body: These terms are governed by Tunisian law.
